description: Latest golden references for Foundation Model + Reinforcement Learning brain research (Updated with 2024-2025 breakthrough papers)

prolonged_rl_training.description: Prolonged reinforcement learning for expanding reasoning capabilities

papers.title: ProRL: Prolonged Reinforcement Learning Expands Reasoning Boundaries in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Demonstrates that prolonged RL training can uncover novel reasoning strategies inaccessible to base models, even under extensive sampling. ProRL v2 sets new records for 1.5B reasoning models with KL divergence control and reference policy resetting.
papers.impact: Critical - Direct application for brain foundation models with extended RL training

rl_pretraining_objectives.description: Reinforcement learning integrated into pretraining phase

papers.title: RLP: Reinforcement as a Pretraining Objective
papers.abstract: Weaves reasoning directly into pretraining by rewarding chain-of-thought based on information gain for next-token prediction. +19% improvement on Qwen3-1.7B, +23% on science reasoning with 200B fewer tokens.
papers.impact: Critical - Revolutionary approach for RL in foundation model pretraining

structured_reasoning_rl.description: Structured reasoning and explanation via reinforcement learning

papers.title: SEER: Facilitating Structured Reasoning and Explanation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Structure-based return for hierarchical reasoning, 6.9% improvement on EntailmentBank, outstanding cross-dataset generalization. Addresses logical dependencies between reasoning steps.
papers.impact: High - Structured reasoning framework for brain signal interpretation

multi_domain_rl.description: Multi-domain reinforcement learning beyond mathematical reasoning

papers.title: Nemotron-CrossThink: Scaling Self-Learning beyond Math Reasoning
papers.abstract: First systematic framework for multi-domain RL beyond math. +30.1% on MATH-500, +12.8% on MMLU-Pro, 28% fewer tokens for correct answers. Incorporates multi-domain and multi-format data with verifiable reward mechanisms.
papers.impact: High - Multi-domain RL applicable to diverse brain analysis tasks

multi_turn_agent_rl.description: Multi-turn reinforcement learning for LLM agents

papers.title: RAGEN: Understanding Self-Evolution in LLM Agents via Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: StarPO framework for trajectory-level agent RL, addresses 'Echo Trap' problem in multi-turn training, introduces stabilized StarPO-S variant. Modular system for training interactive LLM agents.
papers.impact: High - Multi-turn RL essential for adaptive brain foundation models

brain_foundation_models_2024.description: Latest brain foundation models research and surveys

papers.title: Brain Foundation Models: A Survey on Advancements in Neural Signal Processing and Brain Discovery
papers.abstract: Transformative paradigm in computational neuroscience, offering revolutionary framework for processing diverse neural signals. Identifies architecture optimization challenges for EEG/fMRI integration and computational efficiency needs.
papers.impact: Critical - Foundational survey for brain-specific foundation models

brain_rl_connections.description: Connections between reinforcement learning and brain neuroscience

papers.title: Advanced Reinforcement Learning and Its Connections with Brain Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Identifies 3 advanced RL algorithms related to micro-neural brain activity: distributional RL, stigmergy RL, and SR RL. These approaches can be extended to deep RL algorithms using neural networks as functional approximations.

papers.title: Brain-like neural dynamics for behavioral control develop through reinforcement learning
papers.abstract: Demonstrates brain-like neural dynamics development through RL for behavioral control mechanisms, providing insights into neural circuit formation and adaptation.
papers.impact: High - Direct brain-RL integration for behavioral modeling

yejin_choi_recent_work.description: Yejin Choi's latest contributions to reasoning and RL in language models

papers.title: Symbolic Working Memory Enhances Language Models for Complex Rule Application
papers.abstract: Neurosymbolic framework for multi-step rule application. External working memory augmentation for LLMs addresses performance drops in multi-step reasoning scenarios through structured memory mechanisms.
papers.impact: High - Working memory concepts for brain signal processing

papers.title: UNcommonsense Reasoning: Abductive Reasoning about Uncommon Situations
papers.abstract: Abductive reasoning for uncommonsense scenarios, handling unexpected outcomes through robust reasoning frameworks applicable to edge cases in data interpretation.
papers.impact: Medium - Robust reasoning for edge cases in brain data

brain_inspired_optimization.description: Brain-inspired optimization and efficient RL approaches

papers.title: Efficient Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning via Brain-Inspired Computing
papers.abstract: QHD (Hyperdimensional RL) mimics brain properties for robust real-time learning. Lightweight brain-inspired model learns optimal policy in unknown environments with computational efficiency.

papers.title: The Neural Architecture of Theory-based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Theory representations in prefrontal cortex, theory updating mechanisms across brain regions. Provides neural architecture insights for theory-based RL implementations.
papers.impact: Medium - Neural architecture insights for theory-based RL
